Driver Controller (Port 0)
Left Stick → translation (vx, vy)
Right Stick X → rotation (omega)
Triggers → throttle multiplier
A (hold) → MoveTurretToAngle(0°)
B (hold) → MoveTurretToAngle(90°)
X (hold) → Turret SysId sweep
